supersedes_timing: The four-process screen stopped after swapping began while loading. These cases use the same binaries and probe with at most two live models. Do not pool the runs.
sample_spacing: Each of two blocks has one same-binary control, one reference/pair, and one reference/shared comparison; the second block reverses comparison order and first-arm order. Each round alternates first arm independently of case order. Three prefix prepares per host block; all comparisons use the same probe executable per runtime.
adoption: All numerical signatures and capacities match in every arm. Both eligible candidates need stable controls and memory, no prefill or 1-session regression, and both 2-session decode wins. The shared candidate also needs the direct incremental gate. Repeat an eligible path on pinned Qwen2.5 7B on Apple M4 before landing. Stop rather than retry on a failed performance gate.
